about: The work machine's mixed policy: the design seat runs on the Claude subscription (the claude adapter, on the subscription's strongest model) and falls back to pi-designer on Amazon Bedrock when the subscription refuses or its window is spent; the build, review and scout seats run on pi through Bedrock exactly as backend-policy.bedrock.json has them. It is the owner's split of 2026-11-15: designers on the subscription, workhorses on pi, every backend in use at once. Why and how: docs/design/tillr-claude-backend.md. Like the other per-machine files it is the stopgap docs/design/tillr-convergence.md OQ-TC2 records.

seat_purposes.design: Settle design decisions and specify the intended change.
seat_purposes.build: Implement the change described by the item or plan.
seat_purposes.review: Review the candidate against the criteria.
seat_purposes.scout: Search the tree and report findings without writing.
seat_purposes.plan: Read the item and tree and write the piece list.
seat_purposes.edit: Apply a settled edit named in the plan.
seat_purposes.test-run: Run a named check and report its result without fixing it.
seat_purposes.verify: Join the pieces and verify the combined result.
